Okay, and then, attempt to head north. With that done, move west. Then, try to travel south. With that accomplished, move east. That done, make an effort to go south. Then, head west. After that, attempt to head west. Then, attempt to travel north. Then, take a trip north. Okay, and then, pick up the coin from the floor of the super hot canteen. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
